verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an AI Editor that lets users create and modify ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts. That is a real but narrow natural-language control surface limited to one module. Its other AI features (evidence gap analysis, AI-assisted due diligence) are automated analyses, not natural-language commands for operating the platform. Missing for 10: a general natural-language assistant or command interface across the product (controls, policies, risks, audits, access reviews), detailed docs on what the AI Editor can do, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
